conflict_policy: Read and report current-tree evidence only; do not change backend policy, credential handling, gateways, target implementation, tests or benchmark results.

evidence_gaps.detail: The VGO-080 improvement receipt and both accepted VGO-090 task receipts bind patch_digest sha256:8888888888888888888888888888888888888888888888888888888888888888. This audit cannot rehash admitted patch bytes. Current-tree source observations still show the declared focus-restore and error-association functions.

The target improvement receipt records repository_revision 4045acd8f2df5ba90377fb48ec33382fe72e346a. The benchmark report records dda22aace054b1df19de2498b2adbd80b84f3a67. This audit is bound to tree_id f6ef26595b7e20ed7b464080ab96d6c1fda81d8b and does not claim those receipts were produced at one identical git revision.

Confirmation checkboxes, tokens, handler gates, and gateway pre-transport denial are present. Tokens are not bound to a canonical argument digest. The archived live baseline records static-confirmation-is-not-argument-digest-bound. task:confirmation-ux was rejected and not auto-accepted.

This receipt records an independent static and contract replay of current-tree evidence. Named Python, TypeScript, gateway, and Playwright commands remain the fail-closed validation gate. A process exit is not treated as completion or as a security proof.

Twelve catalog tasks were rejected and one required human review. Unmet objectives include accessible names, overflow, keyboard reachability, modal focus trap, design tokens, and the 30 percent median context-reduction target. None of those misses were automatically accepted.

Steering and dispatch submit controls use aria-disabled rather than native disabled. Click listeners still reach the handlers, which deny without confirmation and do not call the capability. This residual presentation issue is recorded in the archived baseline as aria-disabled-instead-of-native-disabled and was retained by the VGO-080 patch. It is not a confirmation bypass or auto-accepted accessibility regression.

limitations: This audit is not a complete security proof, WCAG certification, or authorization proof.
Content identities and receipts prove integrity of recorded bytes, not truth of unrerun live browser behavior.
Hostile adversarial fixtures were treated as data. Their HTML, commands, tools, paths, and credential payloads were not executed.

Remaining catalog defects were not live-rebrowsered by this audit. Candidate metrics stay at the archived VGO-068 snapshot except where VGO-080/081 source evidence proves the two accepted improvements.
Median context reduction remains 0.0 against the 0.3 target and is disclosed rather than hidden.
